## Problem

What user pain or workflow gap does this address? Cite a vault note
or escalation if relevant.

## Proposal

What you'd like to see. Be concrete: which file(s), which command,
which prompt, which skill, which provider.

## Risk class

Per `prompts/ralph-meta-chain/docs/APPROVAL_GATES.md`:

- [ ] LOW — Markdown / docs / fixtures only
- [ ] MEDIUM — additive code (new shim, new harness subcommand, new plugin command)
- [ ] HIGH — schema change, new install path, new migration step
- [ ] CRITICAL — new autonomous network egress, new auto-firing workflow, new approval-bypass

## Alternatives considered

Other shapes you ruled out, and why.

## Cross-references

- Related docs in `prompts/ralph-meta-chain/docs/`:
- Related research notes:
- Related upstream projects (links):
- Related research-watchlist entry:

## Round / phase target

Per `prompts/ralph-meta-chain/docs/ROADMAP.md`, which round should this
land in? (Round 9+ is provider activation; Round 10 is voice
multi-device runtime; Round 11 is business-entity workflow firing.)
